udhr-spa.subject: La voluntad del pueblo

udhr-arb.subject: إرادة الشعب
udhr-arb.because: copula rule 3 — overt 'هي' + definite unique role: Arabic words the role as 'مصدر' (THE SOURCE of authority) where English words 'the basis' — same identificational frame, different role-noun, noted

udhr-cmn_hans.subject: 人民的意志
